title: the camera chain scale, a recursive product up the parent links, 0x141ffe590
notes: Read from the body: if node[0x298] == 0 return node[0x270]; else if node[0x230] & 0x400000000 return node[0x270]; else return chain_scale(node[0x298]) * node[0x270]. The link is tested before the flag, so a node with no link never reads its flags.
The stop bit ends the walk at that node but still includes its own scale; the ancestors are not visited.
Guest addresses: the client's only argument is the node (`rcx`); the guest base rides in `rdx`, which the body never reads, so the probe can translate the links without changing what the client does.

Cases: six chains (one node; a product of three; the stop bit on the middle and on the root; a zero scale; a chain of eight), and (i // 6) % len starts the walk at a later node so the product's tail is exercised too.
acknowledgedGaps: What the scale and the flag mean to the camera is not read: the unit pins the arithmetic.
The client's recursion is expressed as recursion here; a deep chain would exhaust the stack in both, so the corpus stops at eight.
